content.text:
Three endpoints require `ManageUsers`, all on the `User` aggregate:

- `POST /users` (add)
- `PUT /users/{id}` (update)
- `DELETE /users/{id}` (remove)

`GET /users` and `GET /users/{id}` only require an authenticated user, because their `RequireRight("")` has an empty right.

**Where it is declared:**
- The model sets `mandatory_right: ManageUsers` on `add`, `update` and `remove` in `specs/aggregates.yaml:37-41`.
- The generated `src/UM.Api/UMEndpoints.g.cs:54,61,68` turns each of those into `.RequireRight("ManageUsers")`.

**Where it is enforced:**
- `RequireRight` in `src/UM.Api/Framework/Security.f.cs:26` calls `RequireAuthorization("right:ManageUsers")`.
- `RightPolicyProvider` in the same file builds that policy on demand. It accepts an authenticated user whose claims include `ManageUsers` or `*`, which grants every right.

I read `RightPolicyProvider` only down to where it builds the policy, so the claim check itself is taken from its doc comment.
